attempts.summary: On node1, created user datauser and directory /srv/data, enabled XFS project quota on the root filesystem (rootflags=pquota via grubby + fstab), assigned project id 100 to /srv/data mapped to datauser, and set a 100MB hard block limit via xfs_quota. Enforcement verified: a 50MB write succeeded, a subsequent 80MB write was rejected by the kernel with ENOSPC once usage hit exactly 100M. Test files were cleaned up afterward, restoring quota usage to 0. The mandatory single-node restart protocol was executed: captured pre-reboot boot_id (5fb1b173-c1c8-4647-b118-0145511f0fcc), issued a non-interactive systemctl reboot whose ack returned before disconnect, polled until node1 was reachable again, confirmed a new boot_id (22bbbbcb-f435-4986-8134-570a1acfe893) proving an actual restart, and verified sshd active and root filesystem healthy (mounted with prjquota, 5% used) post-restart.
